title: M9 Game submissions
description: Friends who host games elsewhere give Gametronyx a URL; the server takes a screenshot, writes a short description, and Tyler approves a cartridge whose Play button links out to the game. DESIGN §16.

title: M10 Leaderboard follow-ups
description: The leaderboard pieces deferred in DESIGN §13: the /admin Leaderboards tab, a player opt-out, and dropping disabled accounts from boards.

title: M11 Creator tools
description: Creators own their cartridges: they edit them, see play counts, and read feedback players leave on their games. Their games can use Gametronyx login and leaderboards.

title: M12 Discord per game
description: Discord goes live for scheduled sessions, each game can carry its own Discord link, and creators' multiplayer games can run scheduled sessions.

title: M13 Community
description: Gametronyx becomes a place to find games: community guidelines for an AI-neutral-to-positive crowd, browsing by platform and player count, and member profiles.

title: Later
description: Deferred items kept for reference (DESIGN §13 and LAUNCH_CHECKLIST Part G). Not scheduled.
